title.id: Titik Nol: Kabut di Pasar Basah Huanan
title.en: Ground Zero: The Huanan Wet Market Enigma

flash.id: EPISENTER AWAL: Klaster pneumonia misterius terdeteksi di sekitar kios satwa liar ilegal.
flash.en: FIRST EPICENTER: Cluster of mysterious pneumonia detected around illegal wildlife stalls.

mutationType.en: Zoonotic Spillover via ACE2 Receptor

clinicalTarget.id: Pneumonia interstitial akut, lesi paru ground-glass bilateral
clinicalTarget.en: Acute interstitial pneumonia, bilateral ground-glass opacities

description.id: Di lorong basah dan remang Pasar Grosir Makanan Laut Huanan di Distrik Jianghan, Wuhan, beberapa pedagang dan pengunjung dilarikan ke Rumah Sakit Wuhan Jinyintan dengan demam tinggi dan sesak napas akut. Sampel bilasan bronkoalveolar pertama yang diambil oleh dokter mengungkap struktur virus korona baru yang belum pernah terdata dalam genomik manusia. Meski tanda-tanda transmisi lokal makin nyata, desas-desus masih dibungkam di balik pintu tertutup birokrasi lokal.
description.en: In the damp, dimly lit alleyways of Wuhan's Huanan Seafood Wholesale Market, vendors and shoppers were rushed to Jinyintan Hospital presenting with acute fever and respiratory failure. Early bronchoalveolar lavage samples revealed a novel coronavirus lineage absent from human genetic databases. Despite mounting evidence of localized clustering, the deadly finding was kept strictly confidential behind bureaucratic doors.

title.id: Peluit yang Dibungkam: Peringatan Li Wenliang
title.en: The Silenced Whistle: Dr. Li Wenliang's Midnight Alert

flash.id: SENSOR DAN INTEROGASI: Delapan dokter dipanggil polisi usai membagikan hasil lab di WeChat.
flash.en: CENSORSHIP & SUMMONS: Eight frontline doctors reprimanded by police after sharing lab sheets.

mutationType.en: Early Transmission Without PPE

clinicalTarget.id: Infeksi silang nosokomial pada tenaga medis
clinicalTarget.en: Nosocomial cross-infection among healthcare personnel

description.id: Dokter mata Li Wenliang mengirimkan pesan singkat di grup WeChat alumni kedokterannya memperingatkan adanya 7 kasus menyerupai SARS dari Pasar Huanan. Dalam hitungan hari, ia dan tujuh rekan sejawatnya dipanggil ke Kantor Polisi Jalan Zhongnan. Li dipaksa menandatangani surat pernyataan pengakuan bahwa ia telah menyebarkan rumor palsu dan mengganggu ketertiban umum. Di saat yang sama, laboratorium genom swasta diperintahkan untuk menghentikan pengujian sampel dan menghancurkan data isolat.
description.en: Ophthalmologist Dr. Li Wenliang sent an alert to a private medical alumni chat group warning of seven SARS-like cases linked to Huanan. Within days, he and seven peers were summoned by police and forced to sign reprimand letters acknowledging they spread 'untrue rumors that breached public order'. Concurrently, independent genomics labs were ordered to halt testing and destroy existing clinical isolates.

title.id: Jamuan Makan Maut: Pesta 40.000 Keluarga Baibuting
title.en: The Fatal Feast: Baibuting's 40,000-Family Banquet

flash.id: TRAGEDI SOSIAL: Demi mengejar rekor perayaan Imlek, puluhan ribu warga berkumpul di satu meja raksasa.
flash.en: SUPERSPREADER EVENT: To stage festive harmony, tens of thousands gathered for a record dinner.

mutationType.id: Amplifikasi Klaster via Droplet Makanan Bersama
mutationType.en: Cluster Amplification via Communal Dining

clinicalTarget.id: Transmisi droplet masif pada lansia dan keluarga
clinicalTarget.en: Massive droplet transmission among multi-generational families

description.id: Demi mencatatkan rekor tahunan dan memamerkan kerukunan warga menjelang Tahun Baru Imlek, Komunitas Baibuting di Wuhan tetap menggelar tradisi Jamuan Sepuluh Ribu Keluarga. Lebih dari 40.000 keluarga berkumpul, menyajikan 13.000 hidangan, dan berbagi sumpit serta sendok di ruang terbuka yang padat. Hanya dalam tempo dua minggu, komplek perumahan ini lumpuh total setelah ratusan gedung apartemennya terpaksa dilabeli Gedung Terjangkit Merah akibat ledakan demam.
description.en: To project festive harmony ahead of Lunar New Year, Wuhan's Baibuting community proceeded with its 20th annual banquet. Over 40,000 households gathered to share home-cooked dishes in shoulder-to-shoulder dining setups. Within a fortnight, the sprawling enclave turned into a catastrophic hotspot, with hundreds of residential blocks marked with red quarantine quarantine banners.

title.id: Pecahnya Kebohongan: Penularan Antar-Manusia Terkonfirmasi
title.en: The Veil Drops: Human-to-Human Transmission Confirmed

flash.id: PENGAKUAN RESMI: Dr. Zhong Nanshan mengonfirmasi virus menular antar-manusia dan menginfeksi nakes.
flash.en: OFFICIAL ADMISSION: High-level epidemiologist confirms human transmission and healthcare staff infection.

mutationType.en: Human-to-Human Respiratory Mucosal Penetration

clinicalTarget.id: Penyebaran cepat melalui partikel aerosol dan droplet
clinicalTarget.en: Rapid transmission via aerosols and respiratory droplets

description.id: Setelah berminggu-minggu pejabat bersikeras menyatakan tidak ada bukti jelas penularan antar-manusia dan penyakit masih dapat dicegah serta dikendalikan, pakar respirasi senior Dr. Zhong Nanshan muncul dalam siaran langsung CCTV News. Ia mengonfirmasi fakta pahit: dua pasien di Guangdong tertular tanpa pernah ke Wuhan, dan belasan tenaga medis telah tumbang terinfeksi. Pernyataan malam itu seketika meruntuhkan kepalsuan dan menyalakan kepanikan di 1,4 miliar penduduk.
description.en: Following weeks of official claims that there was 'no clear evidence of human-to-human transmission', veteran epidemiologist Dr. Zhong Nanshan addressed state broadcaster CCTV. He confirmed what doctors long feared: two patients in Guangdong were infected via relatives, and over a dozen medical personnel had fallen ill, exposing the outbreak's uncontained trajectory.

title.id: Gembok Besi: Wuhan Lockdown Jam 10 Pagi
title.en: The Iron Seal: Wuhan Lockdown at 10 AM

flash.id: KARANTINA TERBESAR: Pintu tol diblokade, stasiun Hankou ditutup, 11 juta jiwa terisolasi total.
flash.en: UNPRECEDENTED SIEGE: Highway tolls shut, transit severed, 11 million residents quarantined overnight.

mutationType.id: Pemotongan Arus Mobilitas Terbesar Abad Ini
mutationType.en: Historic Mega-City Cordon Sanitaire

clinicalTarget.id: Isolasi klaster metropolitan penuh
clinicalTarget.en: Total metropolitan cluster isolation

description.id: Pukul 02.00 dini hari menjelang malam Tahun Baru Imlek, Markas Komando Pencegahan Wabah Wuhan mengeluarkan maklumat darurat: seluruh bus, subway, feri penumpang, dan penerbangan keluar dihentikan mulai pukul 10.00 pagi. Kepanikan pecah seketika. Ratusan ribu warga berdesakan di Stasiun Hankou berebut naik kereta terakhir sebelum peron digembok aparat bersenjata. Sejak detik itu, kota metropolitan berpenduduk 11 juta jiwa diputus total dari peradaban luar.
description.en: At 2:00 AM on the eve of Lunar New Year, Wuhan authorities issued Emergency Order No. 1: all public buses, subways, ferries, and outgoing flights were suspended from 10:00 AM. A chaotic exodus erupted through the damp winter night as thousands raced to Hankou Railway Station to catch the last departing trains. When the turnstiles were padlocked, an 11-million-person metropolis was sealed from the world.

title.id: Benteng Prefabrikasi: Huoshenshan dalam 10 Hari
title.en: Prefabricated Siege: Huoshenshan Built in 10 Days

flash.id: LOGISTIK KILAT: Ribuan ekskavator dan 40 juta penonton siaran langsung pembangunan RS darurat.
flash.en: ENGINEERING MARVEL: Armies of excavators and 40 million live streamers witness a 10-day field hospital.

mutationType.en: Rapid Negative-Pressure Facility Deployment

clinicalTarget.id: Penampungan 2.600 pasien dengan gagal napas akut
clinicalTarget.en: Triage & care for 2,600 acute respiratory failure patients

description.id: Dengan IGD rumah sakit yang kolaps dan pasien sekarat terlantar di lorong, pemerintah meluncurkan operasi logistik militer tanpa tanding: membangun RS Huoshenshan (1.000 ranjang) dan Leishenshan (1.600 ranjang) dari nol dalam tempo 10 hari. Ribuan ekskavator meratakan bukit lumpur di bawah sorotan lampu tembak genset. Lebih dari 40 juta pemirsa di seluruh dunia menyaksikan siaran langsung tanpa henti aksi para pekerja merakit ratusan kontainer bertekanan negatif.
description.en: With city clinics overwhelmed and oxygen-depleted patients gasping in freezing hallways, the state initiated an extreme engineering offensive: constructing the 1,000-bed Huoshenshan and 1,600-bed Leishenshan hospitals from scratch in just ten days. Thousands of heavy excavators graded muddy swaths under blazing spotlights, watched 24/7 by over 40 million online viewers monitoring the assembly of negative-pressure isolation wards.

title.id: Malam Tanpa Tidur: Gugurnya Li Wenliang
title.en: Sleepless Night: The Martyrdom of Dr. Li Wenliang

flash.id: KEMATIAN SANG SAKSI: Tagar 'Kami Ingin Kebebasan Berpendapat' meledak di Weibo sebelum disapu bersih sensor.
flash.en: NATIONAL GRIEF: The whistleblower's death ignites public fury; 'We Want Free Speech' trends before purges.

mutationType.id: Paparan Muatan Viral Tinggi ke Saluran Napas Atas
mutationType.en: High-Dose Viral Load Exposure to Airway

clinicalTarget.id: ARDS fulminan pada pasien muda non-komorbid
clinicalTarget.en: Fulminant ARDS in young individuals without comorbidities

description.id: Pada 7 Februari pukul 02.58 dini hari, jantung Dr. Li Wenliang akhirnya berhenti berdetak di ruang ICU RS Pusat Wuhan setelah berminggu-minggu bertarung melawan virus yang pernah ia peringatkan. Kabar kematiannya menyulut gelombang kemarahan publik terbesar dalam sejarah internet Tiongkok. Jutaan warganet membanjiri Weibo menuntut kebebasan berpendapat dan akuntabilitas pejabat. Bot sensor bekerja panik menghapus unggahan, namun kolom komentar Li Wenliang selamanya berubah menjadi Tembok Ratapan Digital.
description.en: At 2:58 AM on February 7, Dr. Li Wenliang succumbed to COVID-19 in Wuhan Central Hospital's intensive care unit. His death triggered an unprecedented wave of public grief and outrage across Chinese cyberspace. Millions flooded Weibo with calls for free speech and official accountability. While algorithmic filters frantically scrubbed viral posts into the morning, Dr. Li's last Weibo entry became a permanent digital 'Wailing Wall'.

title.id: Karantina GOR Raksasa: Era Rumah Sakit Fangcang
title.en: Communal Quarantine: The Rise of Fangcang Shelters

flash.id: PEMISAHAN TOTAL: Gelanggang olahraga disulap jadi barak isolasi puluhan ribu ranjang.
flash.en: TOTAL TRIAGE: Sports complexes and exhibition arenas transformed into massive isolation wards.

mutationType.en: Mass Isolation of Mild & Asymptomatic Cases

clinicalTarget.id: Triase pemisahan kasus asimtomatik dari populasi rentan
clinicalTarget.en: Triage isolating positive cases from household contacts

description.id: Untuk memutus rantai penularan dalam keluarga, otoritas menyulap belasan stadion dan gedung pameran menjadi RS Darurat Fangcang. Puluhan ribu ranjang lipat berjejer rapat di bawah kubah aula raksasa. Di dalam barak ini, muncul dinamika unik: pasien bergejala ringan membaca buku filsafat di atas ranjang, senam bersama nakes berhazmat putih, dan saling menguatkan dalam ruang karantina komunal terbesar yang pernah dirancang.
description.en: To sever transmission within households, sixteen sports complexes and convention halls were converted into Fangcang shelter hospitals. Thousands of cots stood under vaulted ceilings. A distinct subculture emerged: mild patients reading political philosophy in bed and square-dancing with hazmat-clad nurses, embodying rapid clinical triage.

title.id: Pintu Terlas & Dering Drone Bersuara Kasar
title.en: Welded Seclusion: Iron Bars and Loudspeaker Drones

flash.id: BENTENG APARTEMEN: Pintu rumah dilas batangan baja; drone pengawas meneriaki warga di balkon.
flash.en: HARD CONTAINMENT: Unit gates spot-welded shut while loudspeaker drones circle residential balconies.

mutationType.en: Zero-Tolerance Physical Confinement

clinicalTarget.id: Pembatasan pergerakan fisik manusia secara total
clinicalTarget.en: Total cessation of civilian mobility

description.id: Di berbagai sudut pemukiman Hubei, penegakan karantina mencapai titik ekstrem. Petugas lingkungan menggunakan mesin las dan rantai tebal untuk mengunci palang pintu apartemen warga yang dicurigai kontak erat dari luar, menyisakan celah kecil hanya untuk menyalurkan sayuran dan mi instan. Di udara, drone pengawas terbang rendah menyusuri jendela balkon, memperingatkan lansia yang keluar tanpa masker lewat pengeras suara dengan nada keras.
description.en: Throughout residential complexes, containment was rigidly enforced. Neighborhood cadres used electric welding gear to weld unit doors shut from the outside, leaving narrow slots to slide in winter cabbage and noodles. Overhead, surveillance drones patrolled alleyways, barking commands through megaphones at residents stepping onto balconies without masks.

title.id: Gembok Terlepas: Fajar 76 Hari Wuhan
title.en: Unsealing Dawn: Wuhan's 76-Day Awakening

flash.id: PEMBUKAAN KEMBALI: Sirene kapal Sungai Yangtze menyala; Wuhan mencatat nol transmisi lokal.
flash.en: REOPENING CADENCE: Yangtze ferries sound long horns as Wuhan records zero local transmissions.

mutationType.id: Eliminasi Virus Domestik via Intervensi Total
mutationType.en: Domestic Suppression via Total Intervention

clinicalTarget.id: Restorasi pergerakan dan aktivitas publik bertahap
clinicalTarget.en: Phased recovery of public transit and civic activity

description.id: Tepat tengah malam 8 April 2020, setelah 76 hari terkurung dari dunia, blokade Wuhan resmi dibuka. Menara pencakar langit di tepi Sungai Yangtze menyala dengan proyeksi cahaya hologram bertuliskan Kota Pahlawan. Mobil-mobil membunyikan klakson panjang di gerbang tol yang palangnya terangkat untuk kali pertama. Di stasiun kereta, ribuan pekerja migran menaiki gerbong dengan air mata haru, meninggalkan kota yang telah membayar harga amat mahal.
description.en: At midnight on April 8, 2020, following 76 grueling days of confinement, Wuhan's blockade was lifted. Waterfront high-rises along the Yangtze ignited with laser projections proclaiming 'Heroic City'. Car horns blared as toll gates opened for the first time since January, and emotional travelers boarded trains, bringing an end to the first modern metropolitan cordon sanitaire.

title.id: Tirani Tiga Warna: Rezim Kode Kesehatan QR
title.en: The Three-Color Leash: Algorithmic QR Governance

flash.id: SEKAT DIGITAL: Barcode Hijau, Kuning, dan Merah menentukan setiap langkah hak hidup warga.
flash.en: DIGITAL POLICING: Green, Yellow, and Red QR codes dictate human movement in public spaces.

mutationType.id: Pelacakan Spasial Real-Time Berbasis Big Data
mutationType.en: Big Data Real-Time Spatial Contact Tracing

clinicalTarget.id: Isolasi preventif jutaan kontak spasial sekunder
clinicalTarget.en: Preemptive quarantine of millions via colored digital codes

description.id: Pascabukanya Wuhan, rutinitas penduduk terikat pada satu sistem digital: Kode Kesehatan (Jiankang Ma). Tiga warna menentukan nasib harian seseorang: Hijau bebas bepergian, Kuning berarti karantina rumah, dan Merah berarti dijemput mobil isolasi darurat. Untuk naik bus, membeli sawi di pasar, hingga masuk toilet umum, ponsel wajib diarahkan ke mesin pemindai barcode. Satu kasus positif di mall cukup untuk mengubah kode ratusan ribu warga menjadi kuning secara instan.
description.en: In the post-Wuhan era, civic life was governed by the Health Code ecosystem integrated into WeChat and Alipay. Three dynamic colors dictated reality: Green allowed passage, Yellow required home confinement, and Red triggered mandatory transfer to state quarantine. Entering a grocery store, boarding a subway, or stepping into a public park required scanning a venue code.

title.id: Garis Tes Tiada Akhir: Operasi Swab 10 Juta Jiwa
title.en: The Endless Queue: Wuhan's Ten-Million Testing Campaign

flash.id: BLITZKRIEG MEDIS: Seluruh penduduk kota Wuhan dites swab PCR hanya dalam tempo sepuluh hari.
flash.en: TESTING BLITZ: An entire metropolitan population of ten million swabbed within ten days.

mutationType.en: 5-in-1 and 10-in-1 Pooled PCR Screening

clinicalTarget.id: Eliminasi sisa kantong pembawa virus tanpa gejala
clinicalTarget.en: Eradication of residual asymptomatic carriers

description.id: Ditemukannya segelintir kasus tanpa gejala baru memicu diluncurkannya Kampanye Sepuluh Hari Uji Swab Massal di Wuhan. Lapangan sekolah, kolong jembatan layang, dan sudut jalan disulap jadi bilik uji cepat. Warga mengantre berjam-jam di tengah terik panas dan hujan badai. Menggunakan metode pencampuran sampel (batch testing), sebanyak 9,89 juta penduduk berhasil diswab dalam sembilan hari, menetapkan standar karantina ofensif untuk tahun-tahun berikutnya.
description.en: Triggered by a handful of asymptomatic cases, Wuhan launched the 'Ten-Day Ten-Million Testing Battle'. School tracks, highway underpasses, and neighborhood gates were repurposed into swabbing corridors. Residents queued for hours in humid summer heat to be swabbed by hazmat-clad workers. Leveraging 5-in-1 and 10-in-1 batching protocols, 9.89 million citizens were tested in nine days.

title.id: Doktrin Nol Kasus Dinamis: Benteng Tembok Tanpa Celah
title.en: Dynamic Zero Doctrine: The Closed Border Bulwark

flash.id: ISOLASI GLOBAL: Kebijakan 'Five-One' dan karantina hotel 21 hari mengunci pintu masuk internasional.
flash.en: BORDER CURTAIN: Strict flight caps and 21-day hotel isolations seal external entry points.

mutationType.en: Closed-Loop Border Interception Protocols

clinicalTarget.id: Blokade impor kasus varian baru dari luar negeri
clinicalTarget.en: Blockade against importation of novel international variants

description.id: Ketika negara-negara barat mulai melonggarkan protokol dan memilih hidup berdampingan dengan virus, Tiongkok mengunci pendiriannya dalam doktrin Nol Kasus Dinamis (Dongtai Qingling). Akses penerbangan internasional dipangkas habis lewat regulasi Five-One. Pendatang dari luar negeri wajib dikawal menuju hotel isolasi selama 14 hingga 21 hari tanpa boleh menginjakkan kaki keluar kamar. Aktivitas domestik tetap berjalan normal di balik benteng karantina yang kian terisolasi dari pergaulan dunia.
description.en: As Western nations grappled with mounting death tolls and transitioned toward endemicity, Beijing codified 'Dynamic Zero-COVID' into national orthodoxy. Strict international arrival quotas ('Five-One' flight policy) severed external travel. Incoming travelers were escorted directly into designated quarantine hotels for up to 21 days of isolation, insulating domestic manufacturing at the cost of global disconnect.

title.id: Kasta Jubah Putih: Menguasai Lorong Bersama Da Bai
title.en: The White Hazmats: Neighborhood Governance Under Da Bai

flash.id: IKON PENGUASA LORONG: Sosok 'Si Putih Besar' (Da Bai) bertransformasi jadi simbol penegakan protokol kaku.
flash.en: STREET WATCHMEN: The celebrated 'Big White' transforms into an omnipresent symbol of grassroots control.

mutationType.id: Birokrasi Hazmat Terpadu di Tingkat RT/RW
mutationType.en: Hazmat Bureaucracy at Grassroots Neighborhood Level

clinicalTarget.id: Pengawasan kedisiplinan dan sanitasi disinfektan jalanan
clinicalTarget.en: Enforcing residential compliance and ambient street sanitization

description.id: Sosok berhazmat putih lengkap dengan kacamata google dan sarung tangan karet—dikenal secara luas sebagai Da Bai (Si Putih Besar)—muncul di setiap blok pemukiman. Di awal krisis mereka dirayakan sebagai relawan setia yang mengantarkan makanan saat cuaca membeku. Namun seiring berjalannya waktu, wewenang luas yang dipegang petugas anonim ini memicu gesekan: penolakan izin darurat medis, pembentakan warga yang terlambat tes, hingga penyemprotan disinfektan kimia langsung ke dalam ruang hunian pribadi warga.
description.en: Covered in full-body personal protective suits, goggles, and rubber boots, frontline cadres were popularized as 'Da Bai' (Big White). Initially celebrated as selfless heroes carrying groceries to locked-down citizens, their unchecked administrative power increasingly stoked public friction: forcefully culling pets, shouting at residents in courtyards, and ransacking private homes for heavy disinfection.

title.id: Retak di Dinding Kaca: Varian Delta Menembus Nanjing
title.en: Cracking the Glass Wall: Delta Breaches Nanjing

flash.id: PENYUSUPAN DELTA: Pembersih kabin di Bandara Lukou tertular; klaster meluas ke belasan provinsi.
flash.en: DELTA INFILTRATION: Airport cleaners at Lukou test positive; clusters spiral into 15 provinces.

mutationType.id: Mutasi L452R + P681R Mengakali Protokol Pembersihan
mutationType.en: L452R + P681R Mutations Evading Disinfection Protocols

clinicalTarget.id: Viral load pekat, penyebaran aerosol di lorong pesawat
clinicalTarget.en: Dense viral load, rapid cabin aerosol dissemination

description.id: Keyakinan bahwa strategi nol kasus sepenuhnya kebal dari mutasi virus pecah di Bandara Internasional Lukou Nanjing. Varian Delta yang jauh lebih agresif menyusup lewat petugas kebersihan pesawat rute internasional. Dari Nanjing, penularan menjalar ke penonton teater terbuka di Zhangjiajie yang penuh sesak tanpa masker. Dalam hitungan hari, virus menyebar ke puluhan kota di belasan provinsi, menyeret jutaan warga kembali ke putaran swab massal tanpa jeda.
description.en: The illusion of an impenetrable biological fortress cracked at Nanjing Lukou International Airport. The ultra-transmissible Delta variant leaked through ground crews servicing a charter flight. Infected cleaners subsequently attended crowded performances in tourist hotspot Zhangjiajie. Within days, Delta seeded clusters across fifteen provinces, forcing millions back into routine testing spirals.

title.id: Kepungan Kota Kuno: Xi'an Kehabisan Pasokan Makanan
title.en: The Ancient Siege: Xi'an's Supply Grid Breakdown

flash.id: KRISIS LOGISTIK: 13 juta warga dilarang keluar rumah; barter barang pokok mencuat demi bertahan hidup.
flash.en: LOGISTIC CRISIS: 13 million barred from exiting homes; bartering resurfaces for survival.

mutationType.id: Penutupan Total Tanpa Rantai Pasok Terpadu
mutationType.en: Citywide Lockdown Severing Food & Supply Logistics

virusProfile.r0: Ditekan Paksa lewat Blokade Rumah Tangga

clinicalTarget.id: Kematian non-COVID akibat keterlambatan medis darurat
clinicalTarget.en: Excess non-COVID deaths from hospital entry refusals

description.id: Kota bersejarah Xi'an berpenduduk 13 juta jiwa diperintahkan lockdown ketat mendadak. Akibatnya jaringan logistik kota lumpuh seketika: toko kelontong disegel dan armada kurir dilarang jalan. Warga apartemen yang terkurung kelaparan terpaksa melakukan barter: menukar konsol game atau rokok dengan sebungkus mi instan dan sawi putih. Kekecewaan publik meledak ketika seorang ibu hamil delapan bulan ditolak masuk rumah sakit akibat tes PCR-nya kedaluwarsa dua jam, berujung keguguran janin di trotoar depan klinik.
description.en: The historic metropolis of Xi'an locked down 13 million residents following a Delta cluster, triggering an acute municipal supply failure. Supermarkets were shut and couriers grounded. Starving residents reverted to bartering: trading electronics and tobacco for bags of instant noodles and greens. Public fury peaked when an eight-month pregnant woman miscarried outside an emergency room because her COVID test was two hours expired.

title.id: Sangkar Emas Pecah: Lockdown Brutal Shanghai
title.en: The Golden Cage Shuts: Shanghai's 25-Million Confinement

flash.id: METROPOLIS LUMPUH: Ibukota finansial dikunci dua bulan penuh; jeritan warga bergema dari jendela apartemen gelap.
flash.en: FINANCIAL ENGINE HALTED: Shanghai locked down for two months; screams echo from high-rise balconies.

mutationType.en: Immune Evasion & Stealth Airborne Aerosol Transmission

clinicalTarget.id: Lonjakan infeksi ringan, kolapsnya triase rawat inap
clinicalTarget.en: Mild infection tsunami overwhelming isolation infrastructure

description.id: Kekuatan finansial utama di Shanghai tak berkutik melawan lonjakan subvarian Omicron BA.2. Skema karantina bertahap akhirnya berubah menjadi kurungan penuh selama dua bulan bagi 25 juta warganya. Server aplikasi belanja sayur tumbang setiap jam 6 pagi, sementara anak balita dipisahkan dari orang tua saat masuk ruang observasi isolasi. Pada malam-malam yang sunyi, jeritan histeris ribuan warga terdengar saling bersahutan dari jendela apartemen pencakar langit, memecah kesunyian kota metropolis yang mati suri.
description.en: China's financial hub crumbled before the velocity of Omicron BA.2. A staggered lockdown splitting the city deteriorated into an ironclad, two-month confinement of 25 million people. Residents woke before dawn to fight crashing grocery delivery apps, while infants were separated from parents at isolation depots. Desperate screams from locked high-rise windows echoed through the night across the silent metropolis.

title.id: Suara-Suara Bulan April: Perang Gerilya Melawan Sensor
title.en: Voices of April: The Digital Relay Against Erasure

flash.id: PERANG DIGITAL: Klip audio 6 menit jeritan warga Shanghai dibagikan jutaan kali lewat pemutaran terbalik dan kode QR.
flash.en: CYBER DISSENT: A 6-minute audio recording shared millions of times through inverted videos and QR mirrors.

mutationType.en: Decentralized Audio Encoding Defying Automated Censors

clinicalTarget.id: Penyelamatan arsip suara korban darurat medis
clinicalTarget.en: Preservation of civilian distress recordings during lockdown

description.id: Di puncak keputusasaan warga Shanghai, sebuah video enam menit bertajuk Suara-Suara Bulan April (Si Yue Zhi Sheng) diunggah ke dunia maya. Tanpa visual rumit, klip monokrom ini menyajikan rekaman asli suara telepon warga yang menangis memohon pertolongan medis dan petugas RT yang kelelahan. Saat algoritma sensor menyapu bersih video tersebut, aksi perlawanan digital meletus: jutaan pengguna membagikan file yang diputar terbalik, diselipkan di sela adegan film jadul, hingga diubah menjadi kode matriks agar suaranya tak terhapus dari sejarah.
description.en: During the height of the Shanghai crisis, a six-minute compilation titled 'Voices of April' appeared online. Layering authentic audio clips of dying cancer patients, exhausted ward physicians, and crying parents over monochromatic aerial city vistas, it struck a raw national nerve. As censors scrubbed the file, millions staged a viral digital mutiny: reversing the video, encoding it into QR images, and embedding it on blockchains.

title.id: Bus Maut Tengah Malam Guizhou: 27 Jiwa di Jurang
title.en: The Midnight Coach: 27 Lives Lost in Guizhou's Fog

flash.id: TRAGEDI KARANTINA: Bus pengangkut warga negatif menuju kamp isolasi terbalik di jurang jam 2 pagi; 27 orang tewas.
flash.en: QUARANTINE CASUALTY: Midnight transport bus crashes off mountain highway; 27 negative residents die.

mutationType.id: Evakuasi Paksa Tengah Malam Demi Target Statistik
mutationType.en: Midnight Forced Transit to Meet Statistical Zero Goals

clinicalTarget.id: Mortalitas akibat kecelakaan transportasi darurat
clinicalTarget.en: Deadly crash during mandatory midnight quarantine transfer

description.id: Demi memenuhi instruksi pembersihan kasus di tingkat komunitas, aparat Kota Guiyang memindahkan ribuan kontak erat yang berstatus tes negatif ke penampungan karantina ratusan kilometer jauhnya di tengah malam. Pukul 02.40 pagi di jalur tol pegunungan Sandu County yang berkabut tebal, sebuah bus berpenumpang 47 orang tergelincir masuk jurang sedalam puluhan meter. Sopir berhazmat dan 27 penumpang tewas di tempat. Bencana ini memantik empati dan duka mendalam: Kita semua sebenarnya berada di dalam bus tengah malam itu.
description.en: Enforcing the mandate to clear inner-city infections, Guiyang authorities forced thousands of COVID-negative residents onto buses in the dead of night to remote quarantine camps. At 2:40 AM on a foggy mountain highway, a coach carrying 47 passengers veered off the road into a ravine, killing 27 people. The tragedy crystallized systemic absurdity: 'We are all on that midnight bus.'

title.id: Eksodus dari Kota iPhone: Pelarian Buruh Foxconn
title.en: The Foxconn Exodus: Highway Flight from iPhone City

flash.id: PELARIAN PABRIK: Ratusan ribu buruh menjebol pagar kawat berduri dan jalan kaki ratusan kilometer di jalan tol.
flash.en: FACTORY EXODUS: Thousands scale barbed enclosures to trek hundreds of miles home along highways.

mutationType.en: Closed-Loop Mega-Factory Outbreak of 200,000 Workers

clinicalTarget.id: Kepanikan terisolasi tanpa makanan dan obat-obatan
clinicalTarget.en: Confinement panic, food shortages, and highway walkouts

description.id: Pabrik perakitan iPhone terbesar di dunia di Zhengzhou mengoperasikan skema produksi tertutup untuk 200.000 buruh. Saat Omicron merebak di dalam asrama pabrik, suplai logistik dan pengobatan ambruk. Didorong ketakutan terinfeksi tanpa perawatan, eksodus massal pecah: ribuan buruh melompati pagar pembatas dan berjalan kaki siang malam menyusuri bahu jalan tol Henan untuk pulang ke kampung halaman masing-masing, sementara warga desa sekitar meletakkan makanan dan air minum di tepi jalan.
description.en: The world's largest iPhone plant in Zhengzhou placed 200,000 workers into a closed-loop bubble. When Omicron infiltrated crowded dormitories, food and medical supplies collapsed. Terrified of being trapped in contaminated quarters, a mass defection erupted: thousands scaled barbed wire enclosures and marched on foot along highway shoulders across Henan Province carrying blankets and rucksacks.

title.id: Titik Ledak: Api Maut Apartemen Urumqi
title.en: The Spark in Xinjiang: Urumqi High-Rise Fire

flash.id: TRAGEDI XINJIANG: Kebakaran gedung apartemen merenggut 10 korban jiwa akibat akses jalan tertutup palang kawat.
flash.en: THE TIPPING POINT: High-rise fire claims ten lives as quarantine bollards obstruct emergency fire trucks.

mutationType.en: 100+ Day Residential Confinement Barring Exits

clinicalTarget.id: Kematian akibat asfiksia asap di dalam gedung terkunci
clinicalTarget.en: Fatal smoke asphyxiation behind bolted building exits

description.id: Setelah warga Urumqi dikurung dalam status karantina selama lebih dari seratus hari berturut-turut, kebakaran melanda lantai atas Kompleks Apartemen Jixiangyuan. Mobil pemadam kebakaran terhambat selama lebih dari dua jam di luar gapura komplek karena akses masuk terhalang tiang baja dan mobil warga yang mogok setelah berbulan-bulan tidak dijalankan. Jeritan minta tolong para korban yang terjebak di dalam kamar membakar habis batas kesabaran publik di seluruh penjuru negeri.
description.en: Urumqi had endured more than 100 consecutive days of strict quarantine. On November 24, fire engulfed the upper floors of an apartment complex. Fire engines were blocked for two hours by quarantine gates, bollards, and deserted cars with dead batteries. Ten people died from smoke inhalation. The horror, livestreamed directly from inside the burning tower, broke the collective endurance of the Chinese public.

title.id: Revolusi Kertas Putih: Teriakan Tanpa Kata
title.en: The A4 Revolution: Blank Sheets Break the Silence

flash.id: PROTES TERBESAR: Lembaran kertas A4 kosong diangkat di Shanghai, Beijing, Wuhan, dan puluhan kampus universitas.
flash.en: HISTORIC DEFIANCE: Blank sheets of A4 paper raised across Shanghai, Beijing, Wuhan, and dozens of campuses.

mutationType.en: Blank A4 Paper Resistance Without Prohibited Words

clinicalTarget.id: Runtuhnya legitimasi penegakan karantina tanpa batas
clinicalTarget.en: Irreversible collapse of lockdown policy legitimacy

description.id: Tragedi Urumqi memicu gelombang unjuk rasa paling terbuka dalam beberapa dekade. Di Jalan Urumqi Tengah di Shanghai, kerumunan pemuda menyalakan lilin dan mengangkat selembar kertas putih polos ukuran A4—simbol bahwa kata-kata protes mereka sudah terlalu jelas tanpa perlu dituliskan. Demonstrasi merambat ke Universitas Tsinghua di Beijing, Wuhan, hingga Guangzhou, menyuarakan tuntutan bersama: Akhiri tes tanpa akhir, kembalikan kebebasan warga.
description.en: The Urumqi blaze ignited the most consequential nationwide protests in decades. On Shanghai's Urumqi Middle Road, crowds held vigils while hoisting blank A4 sheets—a silent statement against ubiquitous censorship. The demonstrations leaped to universities and road intersections across Beijing, Chengdu, Wuhan, and Guangzhou, demanding an end to endless lockdowns and restrictions.

title.id: Tembok Runtuh Seketika: Pembukaan Tanpa Transisi
title.en: The Abrupt Thaw: Overnight Dismantling of Zero-COVID

flash.id: U-TURN TOTAL: Regulasi 'Sepuluh Langkah Baru' mencabut tes PCR seketika; badai demam melanda jutaan warga.
flash.en: 180-DEGREE PIVOT: The 'New Ten Measures' end mass PCR instantly; an unprecedented infection wave follows.

mutationType.id: Penularan Menyeluruh di Populasi Rendah Imunitas Hibrida
mutationType.en: Unchecked R0~18 Wave in Low Hybrid Immunity Population

clinicalTarget.id: Ratusan juta infeksi dalam hitungan minggu, krisis obat demam
clinicalTarget.en: Hundreds of millions infected in weeks; severe antipyretic shortages

description.id: Di bawah tekanan sosial dan ekonomi, pemerintah mengumumkan Sepuluh Langkah Baru yang mencabut seluruh mekanisme tes PCR massal dan pemeriksaan barcode kesehatan tanpa masa persiapan. Akibatnya, gelombang infeksi merebak liar: diperkirakan ratusan juta penduduk terpapar dalam hitungan pekan. Stok obat penurun panas di apotek ludes seketika, antrean klinik demam membludak ke jalan raya, dan fasilitas krematorium kewalahan menghadapi lonjakan kematian tak terduga.
description.en: Caught between civil disobedience and economic exhaustion, authorities enacted an abrupt reversal via the 'New Ten Measures'. Mandated PCR testing was abolished, the Health Code dismantled, and travel restrictions dropped with zero warning. Without stockpiled fever medication or adequate elderly vaccination coverage, Omicron swept through 1.4 billion people unchecked.

title.en: Ground Zero Epilogue: The Scars of Three Thousand Days

flash.en: FINAL ARCHIVE: From Huanan stalls to blank sheets of paper; three years that redefined civil crisis.

description.id: Kisah Ground Zero ditutup dalam keheningan mendalam. Selama tiga tahun penuh, Tiongkok menjadi panggung intervensi epidemiologi terbesar dalam sejarah modern: karantina kota terpanjang, pengawasan digital paling ketat, pengorbanan jutaan tenaga garis depan, hingga keberanian warga menyuarakan keresahan mereka. Virus korona telah berbaur dengan napas kehidupan sehari-hari, namun arsip memori dan rekaman pengorbanan manusia di baliknya akan selamanya menjadi catatan penting bagi peradaban dunia.
description.en: The Ground Zero dossier closes on a quiet, sober cadence. Across three years, China hosted the most colossal public health containment effort in human history: the world's first ironclad cordons, comprehensive algorithmic tracking matrices, profound grassroots sacrifices, and courageous civil resistance. While SARS-CoV-2 settled into background endemicity, the scars and memories remain indelible.
